lead.headline: Institutional Infrastructure Pivot: RWA and Regulatory Integration
lead.tldr: A surge in high-value funding for tokenization infrastructure and legislative shifts in Japan signal a transition from speculative assets to integrated financial instruments.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, here is what moved in Web3 over the last 24 hours and why it matters for the quarter ahead.

top_signals.title: Digital Asset Raises $355M in a16z-Led Round at $2B Valuation
top_signals.summary: Digital Asset has raised $355 million in a funding round led by a16z crypto, bringing its valuation to $2 billion. The capital will support the expansion of the Canton Network as banks continue to pilot tokenization initiatives.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The $2B valuation for Digital Asset underscores the massive capital appetite for permissioned networks capable of scaling bank-grade tokenization.

top_signals.title: 昨夜今晨重要资讯（6月11日-6月12日）
top_signals.summary: Digital Asset secured $355 million in funding led by a16z. Additionally, Hungary has removed criminal penalties for cryptocurrency, and BlackRock deposited $138 million in BTC to Binance.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The removal of criminal penalties in Hungary suggests a continuing trend of European jurisdictions refining legal frameworks to attract crypto capital.

top_signals.title: Avalanche Treasury Company (AVAT) officially listed on Nasdaq.
top_signals.summary: Avalanche Treasury Company (AVAT) has officially listed on the Nasdaq exchange following a merger with a SPAC. The company, led by Bart Smith, focuses on the Avalanche ecosystem and entered the public market via a $675 million deal.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The AVAT Nasdaq listing demonstrates a continuing, albeit complex, appetite for bridging ecosystem treasuries with public equity markets via SPACs.

top_signals.title: Japan crypto bill advances with ETF, tax reform path: Report2h, Japan crypto bill advances with ETF, tax reform path: ReportJapan’s Lower House reportedly passed a bill that would bring crypto under the country’s financial instruments framework, potentially opening the door to ETFs and lower tax treatment.
top_signals.summary: Japan's Lower House has passed a bill to integrate cryptocurrency into the national financial instruments framework. This legislative move is expected to pave the way for the approval of crypto ETFs and more favorable tax treatments for investors.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Japan's legislative shift toward ETF approval and tax reform could trigger a significant wave of institutional inflows from one of the world's largest retail markets.

top_signals.title: The CME launches a futures contract on Bitcoin, ether, solana and XRP
top_signals.summary: CME Group has launched new futures contracts based on the Nasdaq CME Crypto index. These contracts cover eight major cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ether, Solana, and XRP.
top_signals.why_it_matters: CME's expansion into Solana and XRP futures increases the financialization of altcoins and provides institutional-grade hedging tools beyond BTC and ETH.

deals.summary: Digital Asset has raised $355 million in a funding round led by a16z crypto, bringing its valuation to $2 billion. The capital will support the expansion of the Canton Network as banks continue to pilot tokenization initiatives.
Figure is acquiring Kiavi for $717 million to expand its real-world asset (RWA) tokenization network. The move aims to migrate Kiavi's assets on-chain to reduce operational costs and enhance margins.

on_the_radar.title: The Japanese House of Representatives passed a bill to regulate cryptocurrencies under the same framework as stocks and reduce the tax rate to 20%.
on_the_radar.summary: The Japanese House of Representatives passed a bill to reclassify cryptocurrencies as financial instruments, aligning their regulation with stocks and bonds. This move significantly reduces the maximum tax rate on crypto gains from 55% to 20% and paves the way for the launch of crypto ETFs.

on_the_radar.title: Binance Instant Exchange has launched tokenized security bStocks.
on_the_radar.summary: Binance has integrated bStocks into its Instant Exchange, allowing eligible users to trade tokenized US securities. These assets are backed 1:1 by actual stocks and are among the first tokenized securities listed by the FSRA.

on_the_radar.title: Coinbase CEO: The platform processes nearly $1 trillion in stablecoin flows annually.
on_the_radar.summary: Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong revealed that the platform processes nearly $1 trillion in annual stablecoin flows and holds $20 billion in USDC. Additionally, the Base blockchain has seen $19 trillion in stablecoin transactions so far this year.

on_the_radar.title: Fidelity's stablecoin FIDD has chosen Uniswap as its liquidity infrastructure.
on_the_radar.summary: Fidelity Investments has selected Uniswap as the liquidity infrastructure for its stablecoin, FIDD. Liquidity pools for FIDD are now live on the Uniswap protocol, facilitating trading for both retail and institutional investors.

on_the_radar.title: Ethena partners with Coinbase to launch its first yield vault product.
on_the_radar.summary: Ethena has partnered with Coinbase to launch its first high-yield vault product. The product is developed by Steakhouse Fi and utilizes USDe on the Morpho protocol to provide yield for Coinbase users.

on_the_radar.title: Bloomberg analysts: BlackRock Bitcoin Premium Yield ETF (BITA) may launch within a week.
on_the_radar.summary: Bloomberg analyst Eric Balchunas reports that BlackRock has submitted an 8-A filing for its Bitcoin Premium Income ETF (BITA). This filing suggests the product could begin trading as early as next Thursday.

on_the_radar.title: LG Electronics, Arbitrum Launch Blockchain Ad Network
on_the_radar.summary: LG Electronics is partnering with the Ethereum layer-2 solution Arbitrum to develop a blockchain-based advertising network. The initiative is expected to launch within this year, marking a significant enterprise adoption of Web3 infrastructure.

on_the_radar.title: Citi launches blockchain marketplace for private companies shares: ReportThe US banking giant's blockchain marketplace will offer tokenized depositary receipts of private company shares amid Wall Street's broad embrace of tokenized assets.
on_the_radar.summary: Citi has launched a blockchain-based marketplace designed for the trading of private company shares. The platform utilizes tokenized depositary receipts to facilitate the exchange of private assets, reflecting a broader trend of institutional adoption of tokenization on Wall Street.

linkedin_post:
Institutional adoption is moving past the 'experimentation' phase and into the 'infrastructure' phase. Today's signals are clear: from Digital Asset's $355M raise to Japan's legislative pivot toward crypto ETFs, the focus has shifted to the plumbing of the financial system. We are seeing a convergence where RWA tokenization and regulated financial instruments are no longer outliers, but the primary roadmap for the next cycle of growth. The launch of CME futures for Solana and XRP further validates that the market is preparing for a broader basket of institutional digital assets. The question is no longer if the bridge to TradFi will be built, but who will control the toll booths.

Is the industry over-indexing on permissioned networks, or is this the only viable path for trillion-dollar scale? #Web3 #RWA #InstitutionalInvesting #Tokenization
